components.name: Archive Tool Button
components.description: Instrument-like action used for hint, pause, sound, and restart controls.
components.css: .ds-archive-tool { display: grid; min-width: 170px; min-height: 45px; padding: 7px 9px; border: 1px solid #5d766d; border-radius: 2px; color: #dbe3d7; background: #203d36; cursor: pointer; font: 400 16px/1.35 'Atkinson Field', sans-serif; grid-template-columns: 25px 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 8px; text-align: left; transition: background-color 140ms ease-out, border-color 140ms ease-out, transform 140ms ease-out; } .ds-archive-tool:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--brass-light, #e4c97f); background: #294a41; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-archive-tool:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #f2d889); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-archive-tool:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-archive-tool:disabled { opacity: 0.42; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-keycap { display: grid; width: 25px; height: 25px; border: 1px solid #789589; color: var(--brass-light, #e4c97f); font: 600 11.5px/1 'Barlow Archive', sans-serif; place-items: center; grid-row: 1 / span 2; } .ds-tool-note { grid-column: 2; color: #9cad9f; font-size: 11px; line-height: 0.8; }

components.name: Difficulty Control
components.description: Square three-part radio control for expedition difficulty.
components.html: Difficulty
components.css: .ds-difficulty { display: flex; width: max-content; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 1px solid #587268; } .ds-difficulty label { position: relative; cursor: pointer; } .ds-difficulty label + label { border-left: 1px solid #587268; } .ds-difficulty input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; } .ds-difficulty span { display: block; min-width: 58px; padding: 4px 9px 3px; color: #93aaa0; background: transparent; font: 600 11px/1.05 'Barlow Archive', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-align: center; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-difficulty input:checked + span { color: var(--blackout, #09211e); background: var(--brass-light, #e4c97f); } .ds-difficulty input:focus-visible + span { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #f2d889); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0); white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Expedition Route
components.description: Lettered archive stamps show current, completed, and locked scene states.
components.css: .ds-route { display: flex; align-items: center; color: #93ada2; } .ds-route-stop { display: grid; min-width: 82px; padding: 0; border: 0; color: inherit; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; font: 600 11.5px/1.05 'Barlow Archive', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-align: center; text-transform: uppercase; grid-template-rows: 28px auto; justify-items: center; } .ds-route-stop:not(:disabled):hover { color: var(--paper-light, #eee3c8); } .ds-route-stop:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #f2d889); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-route-stop:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-route-index { display: grid; width: 24px; height: 24px; border: 1px solid currentColor; place-items: center; } .ds-current { color: var(--brass-light, #e4c97f); } .ds-current .ds-route-index { color: var(--blackout, #09211e); background: var(--brass-light, #e4c97f); } .ds-complete { color: var(--cyan, #74b7af); } .ds-route-line { width: 24px; height: 1px; margin: -20px -2px 0; background: #506b62; } @media (max-width: 520px) { .ds-route-stop { min-width: 24px; } .ds-route-name { display: none; } .ds-route-line { width: 14px; margin-right: 0; margin-left: 0; } }

components.css: .ds-contact-sheet { position: relative; min-width: 0; padding: clamp(13px, 1.35vw, 23px); overflow: hidden; color: var(--ink, #17221d); background: linear-gradient(97deg, rgb(255 255 255 / 5%), transparent 18% 80%, rgb(72 48 19 / 6%)), var(--paper, #d8c9a8); } .ds-contact-sheet::before { position: absolute; inset: 7px; border: 1px solid rgb(61 54 38 / 25%); content: ''; pointer-events: none; } .ds-sheet-heading { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: grid; min-height: 72px; padding: 0 5px 11px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(31 47 39 / 32%); grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 22px; align-items: end; } .ds-sheet-heading h2 { max-width: 920px; margin: 0; font: 700 clamp(1.75rem, 2.5vw, 3.15rem)/0.92 'Barlow Archive', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.025em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-sheet-heading p { max-width: 760px; margin: 5px 0 0; color: var(--ink-soft, #425148); font: 400 14px/1.35 'Atkinson Field', sans-serif; } .ds-remaining { display: grid; min-width: 162px; align-items: end; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; gap: 8px; } .ds-remaining strong { color: var(--grease-ink, #932d29); font: 700 clamp(3.2rem, 5.2vw, 6.1rem)/0.66 'Barlow Archive', sans-serif; transform: rotate(-2deg); } .ds-remaining span { color: var(--ink-soft, #425148); font: 700 11px/1.05 'Barlow Archive', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Photo Frame
components.description: Dark catalogued 8:5 print frame with a persistent grease-pencil observation.
components.css: .ds-photo-frame { position: relative; min-width: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 8px 19px; color: #d8d0bc; background: #18201d; box-shadow: 0 4px 11px rgb(43 32 17 / 30%); } .ds-photo-frame figcaption { display: flex; height: 22px; align-items: start; justify-content: space-between; font: 600 11px/1.05 'Barlow Archive', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.11em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-photo-frame figcaption span:last-child { color: #7f968d; } .ds-exposure { position: relative; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 8 / 5; overflow: hidden; background: radial-gradient(circle at 58% 44%, #b79c68 0 8%, transparent 8.5%), linear-gradient(100deg, #d4c39b 0 29%, #294e40 29% 100%); } .ds-found { position: absolute; top: 42%; left: 29%; display: grid; width: 42px; height: 34px; border: 4px solid var(--grease, #e24c3f); border-radius: 50%; color: var(--paper-light, #eee3c8); background: transparent; font: 700 11px/1 'Barlow Archive', sans-serif; place-items: center; transform: rotate(-8deg); } .ds-found::after { position: absolute; top: -12px; right: -8px; display: grid; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; content: '1'; color: var(--paper-light, #eee3c8); background: var(--grease, #e24c3f); place-items: center; } .ds-frame-code { position: absolute; right: 9px; bottom: 4px; color: #87938b; font: 600 9px/1 'Barlow Archive', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.11em; }

components.name: Instrument Reading
components.description: Compact tabular status block for time, accuracy, and score.
components.css: .ds-instrument { width: 160px; padding-bottom: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(173 194 180 / 18%); color: #d9ddce; background: #172d28; font-family: 'Atkinson Field', sans-serif; } .ds-instrument-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 2px; color: #87a59a; font: 600 11px/1.05 'Barlow Archive', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-instrument strong { display: block; color: var(--brass-light, #e4c97f); font: 700 1.85rem/1 'Barlow Archive', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: 0.03em; } .ds-meter { display: block; width: 100%; height: 3px; margin-top: 8px; overflow: hidden; background: #071b18; } .ds-meter i { display: block; width: 62%; height: 100%; background: var(--brass, #bf9a55); }

components.name: Inspection Loupe
components.description: Shared circular reticle placed at matching coordinates across both exposures.
components.css: .ds-loupe-stage { position: relative; width: 180px; aspect-ratio: 8 / 5; background: #24483d; } .ds-loupe { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%; width: 52px; height: 52px; border: 1px solid rgb(247 224 150 / 85%); border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgb(8 25 21 / 80%), inset 0 0 14px rgb(247 224 150 / 20%); transform: translate(-50%, -50%); } .ds-loupe::before, .ds-loupe::after, .ds-loupe i::before, .ds-loupe i::after { position: absolute; content: ''; background: rgb(247 224 150 / 78%); } .ds-loupe::before, .ds-loupe::after { top: 50%; width: 8px; height: 1px; } .ds-loupe::before { left: -5px; } .ds-loupe::after { right: -5px; } .ds-loupe i::before, .ds-loupe i::after { left: 50%; width: 1px; height: 8px; } .ds-loupe i::before { top: -5px; } .ds-loupe i::after { bottom: -5px; }

components.name: Completion Action
components.description: Single dark action that advances or restarts from the completion curtain.
components.css: .ds-completion-action { min-width: 220px; padding: 12px 18px; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #17221d); border-radius: 2px; color: var(--paper-light, #eee3c8); background: var(--ink, #17221d); cursor: pointer; font: 400 16px/1.35 'Atkinson Field', sans-serif; text-align: center; transition: background-color 140ms ease-out, transform 140ms ease-out; } .ds-completion-action:hover { background: var(--bottle-light, #1d493e); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-completion-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #f2d889); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-completion-action:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Archive Toast
components.description: Polite lower-right feedback for findings, misses, sound, and restart state.
components.css: .ds-toast { max-width: 340px; padding: 11px 15px; border: 1px solid var(--brass, #bf9a55); color: var(--paper-light, #eee3c8); background: #0a2621; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgb(0 0 0 / 38%); opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transform: translateY(8px); transition: opacity 180ms ease-out, transform 180ms ease-out; font: 400 16px/1.35 'Atkinson Field', sans-serif; } .ds-toast.ds-visible { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }

narrative.overview:
The interface reads as one recovered, catalogued artifact under examination. A deep bottle-green blackout surrounds a warm paper contact sheet; the paired exposures, evidence copy, route, and tools all feel attached to that working surface rather than arranged as dashboard cards.

The system is dense, documentary, and tactile without sacrificing state legibility. Condensed archival typography carries titles, stamps, labels, and instruments, while a highly readable body face handles instructions and evidence. Brass, faded cyan, and grease-pencil red behave as material state signals, not decorative accent color.
keyCharacteristics: A warm physical contact sheet dominates a deep bottle-green blackout.
Archival labels, route stamps, and tabular instruments carry game status without a floating HUD.
Paired 8:5 exposures, grease-pencil findings, and a shared loupe make comparison the focal interaction.
Brass, cyan, and red are state-bearing accents, never ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Evidence Color Rule
rules.body: Grease red is reserved for observations, false marks, and urgent time pressure; brass indicates selection and instrumentation; faded cyan marks archive identity or completion.

rules.name: The Warm Paper, Cold Blackout Rule
rules.body: Working content belongs on paper or bottle green. Do not introduce generic white, gray, or blue application surfaces.

rules.name: The Stamped Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Barlow Archive owns uppercase identity, labels, and instrument numbers; Atkinson Field owns readable instructions, evidence, and actions. Do not swap their jobs.

rules.name: The Physical Stack Rule
rules.body: Shadows describe paper, print, or temporary overlay height. Resting labels, controls, and route stamps remain flat and bordered.

dos: Do keep the paired documentary exposures as the dominant visual and interaction target.
Do use brass for selection and instruments, cyan for archival completion, and grease red for evidence or urgency.
Do preserve condensed uppercase labels, tabular readings, fine rules, and clipped square geometry.
Do pair color states with numerals, text, rings, fills, or meter shape so meaning never depends on color alone.
Do stack full-width exposures at 800px and below and preserve the lettered route at the smallest width.
Do retain visible focus, live announcements, reduced-motion behavior, and the increased-contrast overrides.
donts: Don't turn the experience into a centered game card, decorative hero, or floating HUD.
Don't introduce rounded pills, soft SaaS cards, glass effects, or generic white and gray surfaces.
Don't shrink both exposures into untappable thumbnails to preserve a desktop composition.
Don't use grease red as ambient decoration; its scarcity carries evidence and urgency.
Don't hide progress, lock, pause, found, hint, or error state behind color alone.
